g.text: Both stages are evaluated together. Large groups expose more candidates to selection; coverage and full distributions are shown.

g.text: Structural heuristic: min(step 1 near-attack fraction, step 2 near-attack fraction). Best representatives maximize this value; tied scores are not distinct activity ranks.
